note.en: The study adds the Myrmeku power farms deposit, removes the earlier counter-measure modifier and ends the chain.

notes.zh: 审阅注：选择“引走它们”获得合金，并以“被引走的密弥库蚁”修正结束事件链（colony_events_3.txt:7470-7498）。
notes.en: Review note: "Distract them" grants alloys and ends the chain with the lured-Myrmeku modifier (colony_events_3.txt:7470-7498).

notes.zh: 审阅注：“害虫防治”的正文与等待时间取决于9360的选择：密封720–750天、升级躯体/摧毁群落180–210天、捕获（催化帝国）360–390天。
notes.en: Review note: Pest Control's text and delay depend on the 9360 choice: seal 720–750 days, upgrade or destroy 180–210, harvest (catalytic empires) 360–390.
